narr: Slow moving thunderstorms developed over the mountains, as the monsoon plume remained in place on this day. With the heavy rain that stemmed from these thunderstorms along with high antecedent soil moistures from rainfall over the past several days, the flash flood threat remained high with a few reports of flash flooding noted near the higher terrain.
ev: Emergency management reported county roads 107 and 107A were flooded.
Scouring of gravel road surfaces, with deep trenches in some road ditches. Near by normally dry arroyo was bank full.
Emergency management reported that Highway 12 was overtopped with water.
lsr: EMS REPORTED COUNTY ROADS 107 AND 107A TO BE FLOODED OVER.
SCOURING OF GRAVEL ROAD SURFACES, WITH DEEP TRENCHES IN SOME ROAD DITCHES. NEAR BY NORMALLY DRY ARROYO WAS BANK FULL.
EMS REPORTED THAT HWY 12 WAS OVERTOPPED WITH WATER AND NO DEBRIS.
